result.topic_en: Pencil calculations transforming the circulation form u dx + v dy + w dz of a fluid into Lagrangian coordinates a, b, c, defining vorticity-like quantities A, B, C as curls in those coordinates, noting their divergence vanishes, giving the equations of vortex lines, and starting from the Lagrangian equations of motion.
result.transcription:
$u\,dx + v\,dy + w\,dz$
$\left(u\frac{\partial x}{\partial a}+v\frac{\partial y}{\partial a}+w\frac{\partial z}{\partial a}\right)da + \left(u\frac{\partial x}{\partial b}\quad\right)db + \left(u\frac{\partial x}{\partial c}\quad\right)dc$
$\frac{\partial\left(u\frac{\partial x}{\partial a}+v\frac{\partial y}{\partial a}+w\frac{\partial z}{\partial a}\right)}{\partial b} - \frac{\partial\left(u\frac{\partial x}{\partial b}+v\frac{\partial y}{\partial b}+w\frac{\partial z}{\partial b}\right)}{\partial a} = 2C$
$= 2B$
$= 2A$
$\frac{\partial A}{\partial a}+\frac{\partial B}{\partial b}+\frac{\partial C}{\partial c}=0$
$\int$ [-$A\,\partial a + \cdot$-]
$\int C\,\partial a\,\partial b + B\,\partial a\,\partial c$
$\psi$, $m$ [?]
[-$A\!=$-]
$da : db : dc = A : B : C$
$\left(\frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial t^2}\frac{\partial x}{\partial a}+\frac{\partial^2 y}{\partial t^2}\frac{\partial y}{\partial a}+\frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial t^2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial a}-\frac{\partial V}{\partial a}\right)\frac{1}{\varrho}\frac{\partial p}{\partial a}=0$

methods.what: Transformation of the circulation differential form u dx+v dy+w dz into Lagrangian coordinates a,b,c
methods.quote: $\left(u\frac{\partial x}{\partial a}+v\frac{\partial y}{\partial a}+w\frac{\partial z}{\partial a}\right)da + \left(u\frac{\partial x}{\partial b}\quad\right)db + \left(u\frac{\partial x}{\partial c}\quad\right)dc$

methods.what: Definition of vorticity components A,B,C in Lagrangian coordinates as the curl of the transformed 1-form
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial\left(u\frac{\partial x}{\partial a}+v\frac{\partial y}{\partial a}+w\frac{\partial z}{\partial a}\right)}{\partial b} - \frac{\partial\left(u\frac{\partial x}{\partial b}+v\frac{\partial y}{\partial b}+w\frac{\partial z}{\partial b}\right)}{\partial a} = 2C$

methods.what: Vanishing divergence of the vorticity components A,B,C
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial A}{\partial a}+\frac{\partial B}{\partial b}+\frac{\partial C}{\partial c}=0$

methods.what: Flux of vorticity through a surface as surface integral
methods.quote: $\int C\,\partial a\,\partial b + B\,\partial a\,\partial c$

methods.what: Lagrangian form of the equations of fluid motion with potential V and pressure p
methods.quote: $\left(\frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial t^2}\frac{\partial x}{\partial a}+\frac{\partial^2 y}{\partial t^2}\frac{\partial y}{\partial a}+\frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial t^2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial a}-\frac{\partial V}{\partial a}\right)\frac{1}{\varrho}\frac{\partial p}{\partial a}=0$
